sourceEvidence.title: Software Lead, Manufacturing Infrastructure
sourceEvidence.quote: We are seeking an engineering leader to own the software platforms, cloud services, and operational tools that support product manufacturing, deployment, diagnostics, and lifecycle management. This role will define and deliver the manufacturing software infrastructure needed for product bring-up, validation, provisioning, deployment, quality tracking, and production readiness. Working across New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering, manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, quality, and support teams, the leader will ensure these systems are scalable, reliable, secure, and ready for production. Success in this role is measured by manufacturing readiness, data visibility, traceability, cloud platform reliability, diagnostic capability, and operational efficiency. The role focuses on ownership of the software platform and infrastructure ecosystem. The ideal candidate brings experience in cloud platforms, software infrastructure, manufacturing systems, operational tooling, and data-driven engineering. They can lead complex initiatives across organizational boundaries and turn manufacturing data into insights that improve quality, efficiency, and product readiness. What you'll do... Own Manufacturing Software Infrastructure Define and execute the long-term strategy for software infrastructure supporting manufacturing and operations. Build and maintain platforms for manufacturing execution, provisioning, diagnostics, validation, and release readiness. Establish end-to-end traceability across software, hardware, test results, and manufacturing outcomes. Develop scalable architectures that support current and future manufacturing needs. Improve Manufacturing Data Visibility and Traceability Partner with NPI and manufacturing teams to standardize the collection, storage, processing, and presentation of manufacturing data. Build systems that bring together logs, test results, diagnostics, yield metrics, and quality data across manufacturing sites and suppliers. Deliver dashboards and reporting tools that provide actionable visibility into manufacturing health and product readiness. Ensure manufacturing data remains traceable throughout the product lifecycle. Lead Cloud Sol
